title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (15/20): The Wrong Bride
note_en: The adverb 竟然 goes before the verb to show that something happened against all expectation: 坐在面前的人竟然是宝钗 "the person sitting before him was, of all people, Baochai." English signals this surprise with "actually," "of all things," or tone of voice, but in Chinese 竟然 (or the shorter 竟, as in 看到坐在那里的竟是宝钗) carries it.
